evidence: Matches the P2P label and modifies transaction download and orphan resolution logic in src/node/txdownloadman_impl.cpp.
rationale: Fixes a relay liveness bug where non-witness transactions can remain stuck in the orphanage during opportunistic 1P1C relay. Because txid equals wtxid for non-segwit transactions, 'forgetting its wtxid in the transaction request tracker also wipes txid requests queued to resolve orphan children', causing orphan resolution to stall when the parent arrives from a different peer than the child announcer.
